title: Exact renormalization on a recursively assembled bounded interface
summary: A triangular NAE gasket reduces to A'=A^3+3AB^2+4B^3 and B'=A^2B+4AB^2+3B^3, with (A0,B0)=(0,1).
content: A triangular NAE gasket reduces to A'=A^3+3AB^2+4B^3 and B'=A^2B+4AB^2+3B^3, with (A0,B0)=(0,1). Modulo three this becomes A'=(A+B)^3, B'=AB(A+B). A useful benchmark for exact recursive contraction; bounded interface gives tractability, while identical subproblems save repeated work.
whenToUse: Benchmarking exact contraction on recursively assembled networks with a fixed boundary.
limitations: The displayed recurrence belongs to the triangular NAE gasket and its stated boundary convention. It does not provide a recurrence for arbitrary networks.
